selection_rule.eligible_population: train question rows whose video_path does not occur in prior tasks/results/runs artifacts or the already-audited Phase 3A/Gate 1 videos
selection_rule.video_constraint: greedily take first hash-ranked row with a video_path not already selected; one question per video

geometric.question_regex_ignore_case: \b(left of|right of|above|below|behind|in front of|between|relative to|closer to|farther from|distance between|adjacent to|inside|within|overlap|intersect|position relative|located to the (?:left|right)|orientation .* relative to|compared to)\b

temporal.question_regex_ignore_case: \b(first appear|first become visible|appear|disappear|remain visible|visible|visibility|enter|exit|leave|at what point|at what time|how long|when does|when do|continuously visible)\b

scene_region.scene_term_regex_ignore_case: \b(land cover|vegetation|spectator area|baseball field|field|court|parking lot|road network|green space|river|water body|playing area|construction site|landscape)\b
scene_region.question_form_regex_ignore_case: \b(what type|which type|where is|what is visible|what dominates|dominates|main|primary|most prominent|most common|describe the)\b

questions.question: Is the commercial building located to the left of or to the right of the apartment complex?

spatial_constraints: Determine whether the commercial-building region is left or right of the apartment-complex region; the direction is not supplied.
question_only_decomposition.geometric_operation: Compute the left/right relation from region centers.

questions.question: From the aerial perspective, how is the orientation of the large green space in the roundabout relative to the surrounding roads?

spatial_constraints: Relate the large green-space region to the roundabout and road network.
question_only_decomposition.geometric_operation: Estimate the target mask principal axis and compare it with road-region orientation; report unassessable if masks do not support a stable axis.

questions.question: How does the distance between the AMC theater and the Cinemark building compare to the distance between the AMC theater and the parking lot?

spatial_constraints: Compare the distance from AMC theater to Cinemark building with the distance from AMC theater to parking lot.
question_only_decomposition.geometric_operation: Compute region-to-region center and edge distances for the two pairs; report both measures.

questions.question: Are the vehicles in the intersection closer to the traffic lights than to the white building with the green roof?

spatial_constraints: Vehicles are within the intersection; compare distance to traffic lights against distance to the white building with green roof.
question_only_decomposition.geometric_operation: For the vehicle set and both anchor regions, compare normalized centroid and box-edge distances; retain all required entities in a same-frame tuple.
question_only_decomposition.target_identity_scope: group/set; individual-instance identity is not presumed

questions.question: At what point in the video does the large white-roofed building first appear in the frame?

question_only_decomposition.temporal_operation: Find first visible sampled frame for the large white-roofed building.

questions.question: How long is the construction site visible in the video?

question_only_decomposition.temporal_operation: Estimate first-to-last visible interval for the construction-site region.

questions.question: How long does the white and red bus appear in the video?

question_only_decomposition.temporal_operation: Estimate the visible interval of the described bus.

questions.question: At what point in the video does the baseball field first appear in the frame?

question_only_decomposition.temporal_operation: Find first visible sampled frame for the baseball-field region.

questions.question: What type of structure is visible on the left side of the baseball field in the video?

spatial_constraints: The requested structure is on the left side of the baseball-field region.
question_only_decomposition.geometric_operation: Apply the left-of relation to candidate-region centers, then assess category and region coverage separately.

questions.question: What type of land cover is primarily visible in the central median strip of the road?

spatial_constraints: The target land-cover patch is within the central road median.
question_only_decomposition.geometric_operation: Test candidate containment in the median-strip region; use area coverage and center containment.

questions.question: At what time does the motorcycle disappear from the video?

question_only_decomposition.temporal_operation: Find the last visible sample and disappearance interval for the referenced motorcycle.

questions.question: Are there any repeated patterns in the movement of vehicles on the highway?

spatial_constraints: Vehicle regions are on the highway.
question_only_decomposition.geometric_operation: Assess category-level highway occupancy; do not assign one vehicle as the unique target.
question_only_decomposition.temporal_operation: Identify repeated movement patterns across sampled frames; instance-level identity applies only if independently verifiable.
question_only_decomposition.target_identity_scope: group/set; no individual vehicle is singled out by the question

question_frame_sampling.timestamp_source: original source frame index / source FPS
